dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the mid-thoracic region toward the posterior peduncle, terminating in a sharp point at the visible distal limit.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: A moderate asymmetrical bulge is visible on the right lateral margin; the left margin exhibits a comparatively more uniform and linear profile.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median tone; high reflectance across the majority of the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey patches are localized along the mid-to-posterior left flank and the area immediately surrounding the blowhole.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope with low contrast between the primary light grey baseline and the darker mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Several small, high-reflectance circular punctate marks are visible; a faint, fine linear marking extends diagonally across the mid-dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of small, pale punctate spots and a singular fine linear mark on the central dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a well-defined, dark, circular structural recess at the anterior end of the visible dorsal plane.
